description: This file defines a migration class for the OrangeHRM system, specifically for version 4.3.5. It extends a base migration class and includes methods to apply the migration (which is empty for this version) and to retrieve the version number.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Migration class for version 4.3.5 in the OrangeHRM installer. It implements two methods: up() for applying the migration (empty in this case), and getVersion() to return the version string.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Overrides the parent method; no database changes are needed for this migration version.
